map.夏季(6-8月)多数多肉休眠，浇水间隔延长 1.5 倍；冬季(12-2月)生长缓: In summer (June-August) most succulents go dormant, so the interval is stretched by 1.5x; in winter (December-February) growth slows, so the interval is stretched by 1.3x; spring and autumn are the growing seasons and use the standard frequency.
map.暂无植物，请先添加: No plants yet, add one first
map.浇水频率为参考值，实际需结合养护环境（光照、通风、盆器、配土）灵活调整: Watering frequencies are reference values; in practice adjust them flexibly to the care environment (light, ventilation, pot and soil mix)
map.夏季休眠的多肉（番杏科、部分景天科）在高温期应严格控水甚至断水: Succulents that go dormant in summer (Mesembryanthemaceae, some Crassulaceae) need strictly controlled watering or even no water during hot periods
map.浇水原则：见干见湿，浇则浇透，避免半截水和叶心积水: Watering principle: water when dry and water thoroughly, avoiding half-dry water and water sitting in the leaf center

map.为每盆登记上次浇水日期，自动算出下次浇水日并列出待浇水清单。: Register the last watering date for each pot, which automatically computes the next watering date and lists the plants due.
map.推荐间隔(天)与参考范围：景天科 17（15–20）、仙人掌科 25（20–30: Recommended interval (days) with reference ranges: Crassulaceae 17 (15-20), Cactaceae 25 (20-30), Liliaceae 12 (10-15), Mesembryanthemaceae 20 (15-25), Euphorbiaceae 12 (10-15). Next watering date = last watering date + recommended interval. Family notes: Crassulaceae need ample light in the growing season and water when dry to avoid water in the leaf center; Cactaceae are extremely drought tolerant and prefer too dry over too wet; Liliaceae like partial shade and dislike water in the leaf center; Mesembryanthemaceae need strict no-water during shedding; Euphorbiaceae have toxic sap, so wear gloves when repotting or pruning.
map.景天科桃蛋上次 3 月 1 日浇水，间隔 17 天 → 下次 3 月 18 日；: A Crassulaceae Graptopetalum last watered on March 1 with a 17-day interval → next on March 18; a Cactaceae golden barrel cactus last watered on March 1 → next on March 26; a Mesembryanthemaceae Lithops in shedding does not follow the cycle and must be kept strictly dry until the old skin dries off.
map.和按品种名的浇水周期有什么区别？: What is the difference from the watering cycle by variety name?
map.本工具按科属给出统一推荐值与范围，适合混栽或不记得具体种名的情况；已知品种名时用: This tool gives unified recommendations and ranges by genus, which suits mixed plantings or when you do not remember the exact species; when you know the variety name, the frequency table by variety (which separates the four seasons) is more accurate.
map.周期到了但盆土还湿怎么办？: The cycle is up but the potting soil is still wet, what now?
map.周期为参考值，实际以盆土干透为准；通风差、阴雨天或低温时应延后浇水，宁干勿湿是多: The cycle is a reference value; in practice go by the soil having dried out. With poor ventilation, overcast rainy weather or low temperatures, delay the watering, since erring on the dry side is the general principle of succulent care.
map.关于「多肉浇水周期提醒（按品种）」: About Succulent Watering Cycle Reminder (by Species)
map.多肉植物浇水管理工具。内置景天科、仙人掌科、百合科、番杏科、大戟科五大常见科属的: A succulent watering management tool with a built-in watering frequency database covering the five common families Crassulaceae, Cactaceae, Liliaceae, Mesembryanthemaceae and Euphorbiaceae. Once a plant is added, the watering cycle is computed by species and intelligently adjusted for the current season (stretched in summer dormancy, reduced in winter), generating a watering queue sorted by urgency to help hobbyists manage the watering rhythm scientifically.
